newsitem.title: GERMANY: Krauss-Maffei sees appropriate pft growth in 97.
newsitem.headline: Krauss-Maffei sees appropriate pft growth in 97.

text.p: German engineering group Krauss-Maffei AG said on Tuesday it expected appropriate profit growth in 1997.
Management board chief Cletus von Pichler said the company was eyeing a further rise in profits and said this would translate into an "appropriate" rise in the next profit.
Last year the group's profit more than doubled to 18.1 million marks from 7.26 million marks.
Von Pichler said he was confident for the year as a whole as business had got off to a strong start in the early months.
